Caroline (FinOps): Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem — thanks everyone. We need concrete owners/timelines for: 1) delayed token ingestion backfill, 2) invoice corrections/crediting, 3) monitoring/alerting for delayed pipelines. I'll own invoice corrections comms and credits. Who can own ingestion/backfill?

Jon (Billing): I can take ingestion backfill. Will coordinate with Eng for data pulls. Need list of affected customers + time windows.

Sam (Eng): I'll take the infra fix for the ingestion pipeline (race condition in chunked uploads). I can ship a hotfix canary today. Need logs and sample failed payloads.

Priya (SRE): I'll own the new alerting and recurring incident pattern detection. Propose a weekly job that checks ingestion lag > 15m over 3 windows. Also will own runbook updates.

BillingBot: [automated] 12 invoices flagged for manual correction. See https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/178999 for details.

Caroline (FinOps): Thanks. Target timelines: hotfix canary by EOD today (Sam), ingestion backfill job + customer list by EOD tomorrow (Jon), invoice corrections executed by Fri COB (Caroline). Priya to have alerting + runbook by next Wed. Agree?

Jon (Billing): Agree. @Sam do you want me to share the customer list in this thread or drop in the billing spreadsheet?

Sam (Eng): Drop in the sheet pls. Also @Priya I'll need the specific alert webhook and runbook snippet to trigger during canary.

Priya (SRE): I'll paste runbook snippet and alert policy into the spreadsheet. Also adding a recurrence: monthly metering health check (first Monday).

Caroline (FinOps): I'll open the invoice correction tickets and tag owners. I'll also prepare a short customer comms template. @Jon please flag any top-3 customers who need priority handling.

Jon (Billing): Marked top-3 in the sheet. :white_check_mark:
